summary: AutoSwarm là một framework Python thống nhất các AI agent, phá vỡ rào cản ngữ cảnh để cho phép các agent hợp tác cùng nhau làm việc cho bạn.
usecases: Coordinating multiple specialized AI agents for complex task automation.
Enabling context-aware multi-agent workflows for research and development.
Facilitating seamless handoffs and communication between disparate LLM-powered agents.
ideas: Creating a unified orchestration layer for autonomous agents in software development pipelines.
Combining with memory systems to enable long-horizon agent planning across tool boundaries.
Developing context-preserving agent swarms for real-time data processing tasks.
